title: Report: Philip Rivers has "emerged as the focus" of NC State coaching search

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Report: Philip Rivers has "emerged as the focus" of NC State coaching search
sources.description: Six days ago, former NFL (and NC State) quarterback Philip Rivers was identified as a person "expected to be in the mix" for the now-vacant Wolfpack head-coaching job.
